
## 1.4 Run the linear regression by GROUP

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# 1. Clean the data: remove ID3 and keep ID1 and ID2
data_clean <- results_clean %>%
  filter(ID %in% c("ID1", "ID2")) %>%
  mutate(
    ID_numeric = case_when(
      ID == "ID1" ~ 3.8,
      ID == "ID2" ~ 5.43
    )
  ) %>%
  droplevels()

# 2. Verify the ID mapping
print(
  data_clean %>%
    distinct(ID, ID_numeric) %>%
    arrange(ID_numeric)
)

# 3. Fit one linear regression for each GROUP
models <- data_clean %>%
  group_by(GROUP) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    fit <- lm(MovementTime ~ ID_numeric, data = .x)

    tibble(
      intercept = unname(coef(fit)[1]),
      slope = unname(coef(fit)[2]),
      equation = sprintf(
        "MT = %.3f + %.3f * ID",
        unname(coef(fit)[1]),
        unname(coef(fit)[2])
      )
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# 4. Display the three equations
print(models)

# 5. Export the equations to the repository
write.csv(
  models,
  file = "Regression_Equations.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

writeLines(
  paste(models$GROUP, models$equation, sep = ": "),
  con = "Regression_Equations.txt"
)
```
